survey: LED stage light hung from a lighting truss. Truss: two parallel horizontal tubes joined by zigzag braces, each brace ending on a tube. Clamp: a dark block wrapped around the top tube with a visible bolt; a short stem drops from its underside. Yoke: a U-bracket fixed to the stem, its two arms running down either side of the light and ending in matching pivot knobs on the left and right sides of the can, so it can tilt. Light body: a cylindrical can with vent slots on top, hanging between the yoke arms and angled down toward the lower left of the frame. Front: a round rim holding three LEDs (yellow, cyan, red) in a triangle, aimed the same way the can points. Soft colored beams leave the lens toward the lower left, in line with the can. There is no power cable, which is an acceptable simplification.
